**Update 2026-10-16.** This step now reads the annotated tables written by Step1
(`Fig3_panel_B_C_D_variant_eqtl_classification.Rmd`), which uses per-gene LD clumping
(r2 > 0.6 within 50 kb; PLINK 1.9 `--clump` run per gene since 2026-10-21) and classifies eQTLs as local (within 25 kb, all variant types) or distant.
Panel A is drawn twice: the cis/trans map (lead variant within 2 kb, as before) and the
local/distant map.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 10)
```

## 1. Shared reference objects

```{r reference}
ann <- read.csv(ANNOT_CSV)
annotations_gr <- GRanges(ann$seqnames,
                          IRanges(ann$start, ann$end),
                          strand = ann$strand,
                          type = ann$type, gene_id = ann$gene_id, gene_name = ann$gene_name)

roman16 <- c("I","II","III","IV","V","VI","VII","VIII","IX","X","XI","XII","XIII","XIV","XV","XVI")
num_to_roman <- function(x) roman16[x]

chr_lengths <- c(I=230218, II=813184, III=316620, IV=1531933, V=576874, VI=270161,
                 VII=1090940, VIII=562643, IX=439888, X=745751, XI=666816,
                 XII=1078177, XIII=924431, XIV=784333, XV=1091291, XVI=948066)
chr_offsets <- c(0, cumsum(chr_lengths[-length(chr_lengths)])); names(chr_offsets) <- roman16
chr_mids <- chr_offsets + chr_lengths / 2

gene_location_fixed <- read.table(GENE_LOC, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  select(gene_id, gene_name, chr, left, right) %>%
  mutate(right = right + 2,
         gene_id = str_replace(gene_id, "-", "."))

feature_priority <- c(promoter=1, three_prime_UTR=2, five_prime_UTR=3,
                      start_codon=4, stop_codon=5, CDS=6)
prio <- function(f) { p <- feature_priority[f]; p[is.na(p)] <- 99; p }
```

## 2. Build the combined table from the Step1 annotations

```{r build-table}
type_key <- c(SNP = "SNP", CNV = "Gene-based CNV", Indel = "Indel", SV = "SV")
combined <- bind_rows(lapply(names(variant_cfg), function(vt) {
  fread(variant_cfg[[vt]]$annot) %>%
    transmute(variant_type = vt, SNP, Pheno, var_chr_roman = Variant_Chr, ChrPos,
              Pheno_chr, Pheno_start, Pheno_end, causal_gene = Causal_Gene,
              cis_trans, local_distant, local_distance_bp, clump_n_members,
              abs_effect_size = abs(SnpWeight), PValue)
})) %>%
  mutate(var_chr_roman = factor(var_chr_roman, levels = roman16),
         Pheno_chr     = factor(Pheno_chr,     levels = roman16),
         variant_type  = factor(type_key[variant_type], levels = type_key),
         var_genome    = chr_offsets[as.character(var_chr_roman)] + ChrPos,
         pheno_genome  = chr_offsets[as.character(Pheno_chr)] + (Pheno_start + Pheno_end)/2) %>%
  filter(!is.na(var_genome), !is.na(pheno_genome), !is.na(cis_trans))

cat("\nVariant type x cis/trans (lead variant within 2 kb):\n")
print(table(combined$variant_type, combined$cis_trans))
cat("\nVariant type x local/distant (within 25 kb, all variant types):\n")
print(table(combined$variant_type, combined$local_distant))
cat("\n")
```

## 8. Panel A: 2×2 cis/trans facet (Publication-ready)

```{r panelA, fig.width=12, fig.height=11}
PANEL_A_AXIS <- 18   # axis titles (bold)
PANEL_A_TICK <- 13   # chromosome tick labels (bold): larger sizes overlap at the short chromosomes (I-III, V/VI, VIII/IX)
CIS_STROKE   <- 1.2  # outline width added to cis points, so they are drawn larger than trans points

panelA <- ggplot(combined, aes(var_genome, pheno_genome, color = cis_trans, size = abs_effect_size)) +
  # trans eQTLs first (many points, semi-transparent) ...
  geom_point(data = filter(combined, cis_trans == "Trans"), alpha = 0.5) +
  # ... then cis eQTLs on top, opaque, with a dark-red outline that makes each
  # point larger (size still scales with effect size, as for trans)
  geom_point(data = filter(combined, cis_trans == "Cis"), alpha = 0.9,
             shape = 21, fill = "#d73027", stroke = CIS_STROKE) +
  facet_wrap(~ variant_type, ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "eQTL type",
    values = c(Cis = "#8B0000", Trans = "#4575b4"),   # Cis = outline colour (fill is red)
    breaks = c("Cis", "Trans"),
    guide = guide_legend(order = 1,   # eQTL type legend first, effect size second
                         title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
                         override.aes = list(shape = c(21, 16), fill = c("#d73027", NA),
                                             stroke = c(CIS_STROKE, 0.5), size = 4, alpha = 1),
                         label.theme = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
                         title.theme = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"))
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    # plotmath beta: renders without a UTF-8 locale (the cluster R runs in the C locale)
    name = expression(bold("Effect size (|"*beta*"|)")),
    range = c(0.4, 2.6),
    trans = "log10",
    guide = guide_legend(order = 2, title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
                         label.theme = element_text(size = 14),
                         title.theme = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = chr_mids, labels = names(chr_mids), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = chr_mids, labels = names(chr_mids), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  labs(
    x = "Variant position (chromosome)",
    y = "Gene position (chromosome)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    # Axis titles
    axis.title = element_text(size = PANEL_A_AXIS, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
    # Axis text
    axis.text = element_text(size = PANEL_A_TICK, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    # x tick labels vertical: 16 chromosome numerals do not fit side by side
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    # Facet labels
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
    # Panel borders
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
    panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey95", linewidth = 0.3),
    # Legend
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.box.just = "center",
    legend.spacing.x = unit(1, "cm"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
    legend.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    # Plot margins
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
  )

print(panelA)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_FIG, "Fig4_sc2glu.2_only_panelA_cis_trans_2x2.tiff"), panelA,
       width = 12, height = 11, units = "in", dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
ggsave(file.path(OUT_FIG, "Fig4_sc2glu.2_only_panelA_cis_trans_2x2.png"),  panelA,
       width = 12, height = 11, units = "in", dpi = 300)
cat("✓ Saved: Fig4_sc2glu.2_only_panelA_cis_trans_2x2.tiff & .png\n\n")
```

## 9. Panel A: 2×2 local/distant eQTL map

Same map, with eQTLs classified as local (any variant of the clump within 25 kb of the gene;
gene-based CNVs: the CNV's gene start) or distant.

```{r panelA-local, fig.width=12, fig.height=11}
panelA_local <- ggplot(combined, aes(var_genome, pheno_genome, color = local_distant, size = abs_effect_size)) +
  geom_point(data = filter(combined, local_distant == "Distant"), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = filter(combined, local_distant == "Local"), alpha = 0.9,
             shape = 21, fill = "#d73027", stroke = CIS_STROKE) +
  facet_wrap(~ variant_type, ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "eQTL type",
    values = c(Local = "#8B0000", Distant = "#4575b4"),
    breaks = c("Local", "Distant"),
    labels = c(Local = "Local eQTL", Distant = "Distant eQTL"),
    guide = guide_legend(order = 1, title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
                         override.aes = list(shape = c(21, 16), fill = c("#d73027", NA),
                                             stroke = c(CIS_STROKE, 0.5), size = 4, alpha = 1),
                         label.theme = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
                         title.theme = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"))
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = expression(bold("Effect size (|"*beta*"|)")),
    range = c(0.4, 2.6), trans = "log10",
    guide = guide_legend(order = 2, title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
                         label.theme = element_text(size = 14),
                         title.theme = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = chr_mids, labels = names(chr_mids), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = chr_mids, labels = names(chr_mids), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Variant position (chromosome)", y = "Gene position (chromosome)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = PANEL_A_AXIS, face = "bold", color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
        axis.text = element_text(size = PANEL_A_TICK, color = "black", face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
        panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey95", linewidth = 0.3),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "horizontal", legend.box.just = "center",
        legend.spacing.x = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
        legend.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", color = "black"),
        plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15))
print(panelA_local)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_FIG, "Fig4_sc2glu.2_only_panelA_local_distant_2x2.tiff"), panelA_local,
       width = 12, height = 11, units = "in", dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
ggsave(file.path(OUT_FIG, "Fig4_sc2glu.2_only_panelA_local_distant_2x2.png"),  panelA_local,
       width = 12, height = 11, units = "in", dpi = 300)
cat("✓ Saved: Fig4_sc2glu.2_only_panelA_local_distant_2x2.tiff & .png\n\n")
```
